current_state.explanation: The opaque response cannot prove that the request was saved, so it is not treated as confirmed success.

required_server_change.success_status: HTTP 2xx only after the request has actually been saved
required_server_change.confirmation_contract: Return a verifiable JSON confirmation only after the request and attribution payload have been stored successfully.

required_client_change.migration_note: When the server supports CORS, remove no-cors (or explicitly use CORS), parse JSON and verify the save confirmation.

confirmed_success_gate.condition: Only a valid server JSON confirmation after an HTTP 2xx response may show success and send request_submit_success.

offline_event_policy: qualified_50000, quote_sent, order_confirmed_50000 and order_paid_50000 are server/CRM-only and are not callable through the browser event allowlist.
paid_revenue_policy: order_paid_50000 must use the actually paid RUB amount and must not contain phone, name, email, VIN or other personal data.
